patch_description: Since the exact fused-velocity code is not visible in the editable region, this edit instead applies the deadband mechanism as a minimal post-processing step on the output of enhanced_filter_with_trend_preservation. It computes a small threshold from the local noise scale (0.2 × std of first differences), then suppresses tiny slope changes in the filtered output by nudging each output toward the previous value when the increment magnitude falls below the threshold. This targets false reversals with a single lightweight local mechanism (no stacked pipeline stage), and uses a soft shrinkage (increment minus threshold) rather than hard zeroing so that genuine trends pass through with only a small, bounded bias, keeping lag minimal.
